text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And right up until the very last song,
Smart Falcon kept on singing."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew☆ Thanks for the hard work~!
Did everyone already... head home, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Still, everyone listened all the way to the end! So—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I get it!
This isn't a failure, it's a success!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I put all the feelings I could into it...
...I'm sure they reached someone's ears.
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all from here on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yup, let's go all out~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa... Hold on! We haven't even finished our greetings yet!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tachyon-chan and...
Suzuka...-chan?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, Falcon-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good news, truly wonderful news!
Suzuka-kun actually stepped forward and
said she wants to help with the live concert plans!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No. I am――...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The answer you seek lies dormant in the concert.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Suzuka seems to have made up her mind as well!
She told me she'll be putting her all into her lessons starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy...! Let's do our best, Suzuka-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: If we really hold a live, collaborators will...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So this is a live that captures hearts...
The power of song............!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whatever their motives, the live concert successfully brought
more collaborators together for the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a day that made me feel that if we keep doing this, we might gain even more supporters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Status anomaly detected.
Error registered.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I feel 'peculiar.'
